Elandra groeide op tussen de wilgen lang: Elandra grew up among the willows along the Zuiderrivier, where her grandmother kept the guild's herb garden. After the fire in Wilgenrode she travelled the villages as a wandering healer. She is looking for the man who started the fire, but tells no one.
